slots.purpose: Hero: a warm, real and licensed sense of a Samoan wedding as a meeting of two families, without depending on one couple's identity.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed photo from a consented Samoan or Samoan-Australian wedding: the couple's joined hands resting on a folded fine mat, a frangipani or flower ula softly in frame, warm late-afternoon daylight; faces out of frame or consented. Wide 3:2 hero with headroom for a title crop. No church, venue or village named unless licensed and cleared. Never AI.

slots.purpose: Show the families' formal meeting and the tulafale (orator) speaking for one side, with dignity.

Respectful framing, no staged or costumed shot. Consent from the orator and all identifiable family. Never AI.
